File: README.md

Update the local running instructions in the README to include setting S3_ENDPOINT when running with MinIO so developers do not encounter getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND errors.
args.title: Add S3_ENDPOINT environment variable to local running steps in README

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The running locally instructions in README.md omit setting S3_ENDPOINT when using MinIO, causing DNS resolution failures.
